vector_memory.semantic_summary: TrianglePrimitive is a concrete implementation of a 2D triangle primitive, inheriting from MeshData. It encapsulates fixed geometric datavertices, normals, UVs, and indicesto represent a canonical triangle centered at the origin on the XY-plane. Its constructor pre-configures these arrays, providing a ready-to-use asset for rendering systems. It serves as a fundamental, self-contained data model within the rendering pipeline.
